correctness.rationale: Every upward-flat row on a finite chain is a suffix. The source frame conditions reduce respectively to m_i<=i and, for each occurring finite threshold q, m_q>=q. Together they force m_q=q; attained suffix minima then make m a nondecreasing regressive idempotent. The fixed-point plateaux give independent threshold choices whose composition generating function is exactly the Bell-difference generating function. Direct relation-level exhaustive checks through n=6 and independent composition-formula checks through n=12 corroborate the proof.

On the canonical linearly ordered intuitionistic reducts, the theorem gives both a structural normal form and an exact closed search-space count.
